diagnosis: Phone testing showed quick-play m3u8 and HD mov failing while multi-quality webm worked. The failure is in provider extraction before MX: original Q0/S0 extractors rely on dynamic provider configuration that is not present in the host app, while the public page fallback was too narrow for JWPlayer/Clappr file/hls fields and extensionless signed media endpoints.
playback_fix: Original Q0/S0 extraction and safe public-page extraction now run concurrently and the first valid result wins. Page parsing recognizes file/hls/video/src declarations, direct media URLs and HLS bodies. Declared HLS type survives redirects and extensionless signed URLs so MX receives application/x-mpegURL when required.
download_flow: Episode download routing remains aligned with the supplied Drama World V4.2f type switch and TDM/1DM handoff extras.
guest_access_rule: No local account gate is invented for the supplied V4.2f guest paths; real remote authentication remains enforced by the provider if present.
network_probe_note: A sanitized GitHub-hosted probe could not reach the Drama content API because that runner received HTTP 403. This does not diagnose the phone route and no protected validation route was called.
known_limitations: The original app dynamically loads provider regex/prefixurl/hlsuri/header configuration. Those protected values remain unavailable here, so a provider that cannot be resolved from its public player page may still fail. Real-device testing is still required.
